request.text: wardog ran Rubeus on WORKSTATION6 to request a Kerberos ticket for pgustavo from a password hash and opened a shell with it. Disable account wardog.

package.rationale: wardog's elevated PowerShell (PID 5056) started Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:pgustavo /rc4:<NTLM hash> /createnetonly:cmd.exe (PID 7520), which opened winlogon, contacted the domain controller and started cmd.exe under the forged logon: overpass-the-hash with pgustavo's hash. Disable wardog.
